statement: NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $12.93 billion, moving deeper into the open-model and developer-tooling layer above its accelerators.
why: Owning the main hub where developers publish and deploy open models strengthens the software gravity that keeps workloads on NVIDIA hardware.

impact.mechanism: Control of the model and deployment hub reinforces developer lock-in around NVIDIA software stacks, raising the switching cost to rival accelerators.

evidence.excerpt: Together, we will scale Hugging Face's platform, strengthen its infrastructure and expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide.

confidence.basis: Official NVIDIA newsroom announcement with the deal value stated in the release.
